{{Top|leg}}
The [[Kessarch]] were a species of herbivorous [[Mammal/Legends|mammal]] native to the desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Rordak]]. They somehow managed to thrive in the hot, dry desert with little vegetation. They were constantly being hunted by the ruthless [[Viska (species)|Viska]].
